name: Santa Teresa Village
summary: Santa Teresa Village is a neighborhood shopping plaza in South San Jose offering convenient access to fast-food restaurants, a thrift store, hardware supplier, and essential services. This community-oriented center serves local residents with practical retail options in an accessible open-air format.
demographics: Santa Teresa Village serves a diverse suburban San Jose community with a mix of middle-income families and young professionals in the Santa Teresa neighborhood. The trade area attracts residents seeking convenient everyday shopping and services, with a demographic profile reflecting Silicon Valley's tech-influenced population including both established homeowners and renters. Primary visitors are value-conscious shoppers looking for practical retail options, fast-casual dining, and essential services within a neighborhood setting.
description: Santa Teresa Village is a community-focused shopping plaza located in the growing Santa Teresa neighborhood of South San Jose, California. Situated at 7028 Santa Teresa Boulevard, this open-air retail center has established itself as a convenient destination for local residents seeking everyday essentials and services. The plaza features a practical mix of fast-food eateries, a thrift store, and a hardware supplier, along with various service-oriented businesses that cater to the neighborhood's daily needs. With its accessible layout and ample parking, Santa Teresa Village provides a straightforward shopping experience for busy families and professionals in the area. The center's strong community presence is reflected in its solid 4.1-star rating from over 1,200 reviews, demonstrating its value as a reliable neighborhood retail hub in South San Jose's expanding residential corridor.
